dataset_info.summary: Recordings of people saying “computer” to their own microphones, contributed by the OVOS community, used as the clips a detector must wake on. The clips it must ignore are pooled from a shared not-wake-word collection of speech, music, environmental sounds and ambient noise, so the false-alarm figure spans many scenarios. The clips carry real room acoustics and real microphone variation rather than synthesis, though the number of contributors is small.
dataset_info.notes: Real community recordings of the 'computer' wake word (Star Trek-style) as positives; negatives pooled across the not-wake-word collection (speech, public-domain sounds, ESC-50, music, ambient noise) so false-accept rate spans many scenarios. Positives listed in metadata.csv (file_name, label).
